header.title: Stepper
header.description: Shows progress through a multi-step process: a sign-up, a checkout or an account setup. Each step has a number (or an icon), a title and, optionally, a description and content shown while it is the current step. It is linear by default: you can only go back to completed steps, not jump ahead. Use it when order matters; if the sections are independent, `Tabs` works better.

demo.done: Done: the workspace is set up.

account.label: Account
account.content: Create the workspace owner account and verify the email address.

profile.label: Profile
profile.content: Add a display name, a photo and the role this person will have.

review.label: Review
review.content: Check every field before creating the workspace.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props and see the result. Click the steps to navigate: in linear mode only the current and previous ones respond. `alternativeLabel` only applies horizontally.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: Pass `items` with an `id` and a `label` per step. `defaultValue` picks the initial step; the previous ones are completed and the next ones pending. The current step `content` shows below. Translate `navLabel`: it defaults to "Progress".

alternativeLabel.title: Labels below
alternativeLabel.description: `alternativeLabel` centers the title and description under each indicator and stretches the connectors. It looks tidier with many steps or little width. Horizontal only.

vertical.title: Vertical
vertical.description: With `orientation="vertical"` the steps stack, the connector runs under each indicator and the content appears next to the current step. Best for narrow screens or steps with a lot of content.

wizard.title: Controlled wizard
wizard.description: The most common case: control the step with `value` and `onChange`, and move with your own buttons. On finish, `completed` on each item marks everything as done and `showContent={false}` hides the panel.

verticalWizard.title: Vertical wizard
verticalWizard.description: `content` accepts any node, so each step's buttons can live inside the panel. Each action sits next to the content it belongs to.

nonLinear.title: Non-linear
nonLinear.description: With `linear={false}` any enabled step can be selected, including upcoming ones. Useful when steps can be completed in any order, like a profile filled in parts.

error.title: Error step
error.description: `error` on an item marks it red and swaps the number for an alert mark, even when it is the current step. Pair it with a `description` that explains what to fix.

icons.title: With icons
icons.description: `icon` replaces the number while the step is pending or current. Completed steps still show the completed mark (change it with `completedIcon`).

optional.title: Optional step
optional.description: `optional` adds a text under the title, but it is fixed in English ("Optional") and cannot be translated. In other languages, say it in the `description`, as this demo does.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: `disabled` on an item blocks that step and keyboard navigation skips it. `isDisabled` disables the whole stepper and lowers its opacity, for example while saving.

readOnly.title: Read-only
readOnly.description: With `clickable={false}` steps cannot be clicked and the stepper only reports status. Useful for tracking, like an order status, where the system drives progress.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` changes the indicator (24, 32 or 40px) and the text size. The default is `md`.

header.title: Stepper API
header.description: API reference for the Stepper React component: props, items, CSS classes, CSS variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: You can import it from the main entry or from its subpath. `getStepperStatus(item, index, currentIndex)` returns a step status in case you build your own view.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the HTML attributes of a <nav> (HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, except children, onChange and defaultValue) and passes them to the root element. classNames adds classes to each part: root, list, item, trigger, indicator, label, description, connector and panel.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.nav: The stepper is a <nav> with aria-label (from navLabel) and the steps are an ordered list <ol>.
a11y.keyboard: There is a single tab stop. Arrow keys (left and right horizontally, up and down vertically), Home and End move focus between activatable steps.
a11y.linear: In linear mode, upcoming steps are not buttons: they cannot be focused or activated.
a11y.readOnly: With clickable={false} or isDisabled no step is a button. isDisabled adds aria-disabled to the <nav>.
a11y.panel: The current step content is a role="region" named by its step (aria-labelledby), and the step button points to it with aria-controls.
a11y.icons: Indicators are decorative (aria-hidden): the completed or error state is not announced. If it matters, say it in the description.
a11y.labels: navLabel ("Progress") and the optional text ("Optional") are in English. Translate navLabel; optional cannot be translated. Use ariaLabel on an item when its label is not text.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.root: Root `<nav>` element. Receives `className` and `classNames.root` and defines the stepper variables.
rules.disabled: Applied with `isDisabled`. Lowers opacity and blocks the pointer.
rules.itemStatus: Step status: `pending`, `current`, `completed` or `error`. Sets the indicator and title colors.
rules.trigger: Step button (or `<div>` when it cannot be activated). Receives `classNames.trigger`.
rules.triggerStatus: Step status applied to the button. It has no styles of its own; it is a hook.
rules.indicator: Circle with the number, icon or mark. Receives `classNames.indicator`.
rules.copy: Wrapper for the title, description and optional text.
rules.label: Step title. Receives `classNames.label`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Defined on `.gem-stepper`, with their own values in the dark theme. To change them, use a more specific selector such as `.gem-stepper.my-class`. `--gem-stepper-indicator-size` is also set by the size classes.

items.--gem-stepper-muted: Color of descriptions and pending step titles.
items.--gem-stepper-current: Color of the current and completed steps (indicator and title).
items.--gem-stepper-completed: Connector color after a completed step.

items.--gem-color-neutral-0: Text color over the current and error steps.
items.--gem-palette-*: Dark theme colors (neutral, primary and error).
items.--gem-space-1: Small margins of the vertical connector and `alternativeLabel`.
items.--gem-space-2: Gap between indicator and text, and connector margin.
items.--gem-space-4: Gap between the list and the panel.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: Props of the Stepper and of each item in `items`.

stepper.title: Stepper
stepper.description: It also accepts the HTML attributes of a `<nav>`.

items.defaultValue: `id` of the initial step (uncontrolled mode). Defaults to the first enabled step.
items.linear: When `true`, only the current and previous steps can be selected.
items.clickable: With `false` steps cannot be activated and the stepper only shows status.
items.alternativeLabel: Centers titles under the indicators. Horizontal only.
items.errorIcon: Icon for error steps. Defaults to an alert mark.
items.onChange: Runs when another step is picked, with its `id`, the item and its index. It does not run if the step cannot be activated.

items.id: Unique identifier. It is the `value` and what `onChange` receives.
items.label: Step title.
items.icon: Replaces the number while the step is pending or current.
items.content: Content shown while it is the current step.
items.optional: Adds the "Optional" text (in English, cannot be translated).
items.error: Marks the step as failed, even when it is current.
items.completed: Marks the step as completed even if it comes after the current one.
items.ariaLabel: Accessible name of the step when `label` is not text.
